⚡ BetterDt-Trainer

A feature-rich trainer mod for Devices Tycoon, built on top of the BetterDT framework. Manage your in-game currency, research points, and interface themes effortlessly with a custom glass-morphism UI.

💰 Money Hack Add +$10M or +$1B instantly to your budget.
🔬 Research Points Get +100k RP to fast-track your technology unlocks.
🎨 Custom Themes Switch between Gold, Neon, and Dark visual styles.
⌨️ Hotkeys & UI Toggle via F4/Insert, customize position and elements.
